🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Government / USTR
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has passed a bill that could grant President Donald Trump the authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on Indian goods due to New Delhi's continued purchase of Russian oil, prompting Indian suppliers to plan diversification away from the US market. India is also challenging a recently imposed multi-year tariff-rate quota on quartz surface products at the WTO.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(75\% \- The US Senate has passed legislation empowering potential tariffs, and Indian industries are actively strategizing to mitigate impact, indicating a high likelihood of significant trade actions, though not yet fully enacted\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Textiles, Metals/Auto (specifically quartz surface products), OGCs (due to underlying cause of tariffs), EMS (if diversified exports are hit)
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Increased trade protectionism from the US against Indian exports and the potential for higher import costs due to energy choices would negatively impact export\-oriented industries and broader market sentiment\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Indian fund managers should consider reducing exposure to export\-oriented sectors, particularly Textiles and specific manufacturing segments impacted by new tariffs like quartz, and seek opportunities in domestically focused segments or those benefiting from alternative trade partnerships to hedge against escalating trade tensions\.
